- Choose-Task startup: read prior progress, current_tasks.md, and current_tasks_done.md.
- Active backlog contains Story 4 Tasks 2-5 and Story 5 Tasks 1-5, all with <passes>false</passes> in the summary.
- Done list confirms the prior bug task and Story 4 Task 1 are <passes>true</passes>.
- Next: inspect full task files for priority and blocked_by tags before selecting.

- Active task files have no <blocked_by> tags and no active priority tags; all candidates are unblocked <passes>false</passes> non-bug tasks.
- Bug-first branch is empty because there are no active failing bug tasks in current_tasks.md; the only bug listed is completed with <passes>true</passes> in current_tasks_done.md.
- Selected Story 4 Task 2 because Story 4 Task 1 is complete and Task 2 provides document asset fetch/classification needed before extraction/API/deep verification and before Story 5 search work.
- Next: write .ralph/tasks/story-4-document-text-support/task-2-fetch-and-classify-document-assets.md to .ralph/current_task.txt and quit immediately.

- Wrote .ralph/current_task.txt with .ralph/tasks/story-4-document-text-support/task-2-fetch-and-classify-document-assets.md.
- Choose-Task selection complete; should quit immediately per task-selection instructions.

- Startup read complete for Story 4 Task 2: .ralph/tasks/story-4-document-text-support/task-2-fetch-and-classify-document-assets.md.
- Task has no <plan> block and no TO BE VERIFIED/NOW EXECUTE marker, so this is the planning pass.
- Next: inspect existing schema/module/test layout, write a TDD/code-boundaries plan under task-2 plan dir, update task file to point at it with NOW EXECUTE, then quit immediately.

- Created planning file .ralph/tasks/story-4-document-text-support/task-2-fetch-and-classify-document-assets_plans/document-asset-fetch-and-classify-plan.md.
- Updated task-2-fetch-and-classify-document-assets.md with the <plan> pointer and NOW EXECUTE marker.
- Planning pass only; no code implementation or tests were run. Must quit immediately per instructions. Next turn should execute the plan with red-green TDD, starting by rereading the tdd skill and the plan.

- Execution startup read previous progress, current task, and the NOW EXECUTE plan.
- Re-read tdd and improve-code-boundaries skills as required.
- Inspected document_asset/document_content schema and found document_content has document_content_extracted_body_check requiring extracted_text or extracted_html.
- This conflicts with GREEN 7 in the approved plan, which says to switch back to TO BE VERIFIED if pending source metadata rows cannot be represented without fake extracted text/html.
- Next: update plan marker/task marker from NOW EXECUTE to TO BE VERIFIED, note the schema/interface mismatch in the plan, then quit immediately per instructions.

- Switched task marker and plan ending from NOW EXECUTE to TO BE VERIFIED.
- Added plan note explaining document_content_extracted_body_check prevents pending selected-source metadata rows without fake extracted content.
- No implementation/tests/checks run because instructions require quitting immediately after switching back to TO BE VERIFIED.
- Next pass should revise schema/interface design for pending selected official-source metadata before execution.

- Startup read prior progress, current task, task file, and plan.
- Current task remains TO BE VERIFIED because execution found document_content cannot represent pending selected-source metadata without extracted body content.
- Inspecting migrations/schema tests now to revise the plan with an explicit schema/interface correction, then will set NOW EXECUTE and quit immediately.

- Revised the task plan while in TO BE VERIFIED planning mode.
- Boundary change: document_asset remains retrieval/status metadata; document_content must only represent real persisted text/html bodies, not pending selected-source metadata.
- Updated RED/GREEN 7 so official text/html alternatives persist their real fetched body; binary-only PDF/DOCX reports create no document_content rows in this task.
- Changed the plan ending and task marker to NOW EXECUTE.
- Per instructions, next pass must quit this one immediately and execute the plan after rereading tdd.

- Execution pass started from NOW EXECUTE plan for Story 4 Task 2.
- Re-read tdd and improve-code-boundaries skills, task file, and approved plan.
- Inspected syncfeed client/test fixture style and document_asset/document_content schema; no fetcher/repository exists yet.
- Next: add RED 1 sync fixture test for official text alternative discovery, then implement minimal document_asset fetcher.

- Completed RED/GREEN 1 for opentk-sync document_asset fetcher.
- Added public document_asset module, first fixture server test, basic HTTP fetch, content-type classification, official text alternate discovery, SHA-256 hashing, and selected body reporting.
- Narrow test passes: cargo test -p opentk-sync --test document_asset_fetcher html_asset_prefers_official_text_alternative.
- Next: RED/GREEN 2 for PDF and DOCX binary extraction input classification.

- Completed RED/GREEN 3 for content-length validation.
- RED failed because wrong expected_content_length still fetched; GREEN added validate_lengths after body read.
- Narrow length test passes after clearing stale target/debug/deps document_asset_fetcher artifacts caused by a linker artifact error.
- Note: RED/GREEN 2 test for PDF/DOCX passed immediately because binary classification was already covered by the first implementation; continue with status/retry tests next.

- Completed RED/GREEN 4 for unsupported/not_found/retry-exhaustion status handling.
- RED failed because 503 was only requested once despite max_retries=1; GREEN added retryable status handling for 429 and 5xx.
- Narrow status test passes.
- Next: RED/GREEN 5 for fetch_many bounded concurrency and request timeout reports.

- Completed RED/GREEN 5 and RED/GREEN 6.
- fetch_many compile RED led to semaphore/JoinSet implementation with ordered results; timeout errors normalized as explicit timed out messages.
- Added opentk-db document_assets repository and RED/GREEN 6 integration test for asset upsert; direct cargo lacked DB env, supported harness passed: CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 ./scripts/cargo-test-with-postgres.sh -p opentk-db --test document_assets records_successful_fetch_reports_as_document_assets.
- Next: RED/GREEN 7 for official text/html content rows, still no document_content for binary-only reports.

- Full make test passed once after sync fetcher, DB repository, docs, and lint fixes.
- Final acceptance review found expected_content_type was not validated; added a failing test for expected PDF receiving text/plain, then implemented validate_content_type.
- Narrow expected content-type/length test now passes.
- Next: rerun cargo fmt, make check/lint, and make test after the final validation change.

- Final verification after boundary cleanup passed: cargo fmt, make check, make lint, and make test.
- Boundary review completed: HTTP classification/retry stays in opentk-sync, SQL status conversion stays in opentk-db::document_assets, binary-only reports do not create document_content, and content-length overflow now returns a typed error instead of saturating.
- Updated task plan checkboxes and set task-2 status completed with <passes>true</passes>.
- Next: run .ralph/task_switch.sh, git add all files, commit, push, then quit immediately.
